The '''Chasin Document''' was a revised version of General [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]]' [[Operation Blue Plug]]. The Chasin Document was never put into motion because its intended target [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] ousted its [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rulers on its own. The Plan was illegally created by slicing into classified files, presumably done by [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and/or his [[Galactic Alliance Guard]].
